pandas.Series.str.replace

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Replace matching substrings inside each value. Set regex=True for regular-expression matching.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.str.replace(pat, repl=None, n=-1, case=None, flags=0, regex=False)
